trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own. No online play or DLC is needed: every trophy is single-player, and one playthrough is enough. Expect roughly 200 hours in total. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then the leftover strands — so the long collectible grinds happen while you play instead of after.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to the end; the trophy unlocks when the mission completes. Nothing to prepare — just follow the opening beats.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter as a backup — there is no mission replay — and do the balcony meditation in this chapter (see Positive Mental Attitude) before you leave it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 2 in full; the trophy pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 3 in full; the trophy pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 4 in full; the trophy pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the final story mission; the trophy pops at the credits. After the credits you can keep exploring Leonida freely, so nothing is cut off — the cleanup grind starts here.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist. It does not ask for literally everything — for example 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 of 397 stunts — so work down the list and stop each activity once its number is met. This is the longest trophy in the game, and the hardest one to finish.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. The game counts four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, 397 in total — so you only need a little over half. Stunt spots are marked on the map under Exploration; track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so this pops on the way there.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. The Activities menu tracks them: sample a race, the shooting range, a drone race, a fishing spot, an arcade cabinet, pool, mini-golf, a basketball hoop and a stunt spot. One attempt at each is enough — you do not need to win or finish any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — find them under Activities > Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some unlock only once other conditions are met. All 42 golds are also required for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. The locations are listed under Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones; some charge an entry fee. You must win at each location — the 42 drone time trials are a separate 100% requirement, so do not confuse the two.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Race spots appear as you explore; track them under Activities > Racing. It must be 20 different races — winning the same one repeatedly does not count. Most locations let you hire a car; check its Rating, and buy upgrades at Mod Shops if you bring your own.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Early on, Cal asks you to catch a parrotfish over 2 kg — fish in the marked area until you land one big enough. You need a boat with a fishing rod; plenty are moored nearby if you do not own one.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet — bars and arcades around Leonida have them — start a game and play it through to its end. Any single game counts.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Finish Andy's whole mission strand; the trophy pops after his last one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission, Maritime Disputes. Finish Kenton's strand; the trophy pops after that mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission, Hometown Heroes. Finish Billy's strand; the trophy pops after that mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore; a strand counts only when it is finished, not after a single mission. The five named-character strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — are part of the pool, so work them alongside the other stranger encounters you find while exploring.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Finish Randy's strand — his missions include a vehicle wish list, so note the cars he wants as you find them; the trophy pops after his last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Finish Tyrone's strand — his missions run through the Kitty Litter Labs; the trophy pops after his last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy you can miss: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning — when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation. Do that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1, and keep a manual save from the chapter start. The other 17 spots are found via Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida; a meditation only counts once the final 'zen' animation plays. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. (15 of 18 count toward 100% completion.)
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks you to take down specific unique animals — follow his missions and use the hunting tools the game introduces. His strand also feeds the 100% checklist, which asks for all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets in Leonida; finish any three in full. Cards you collect can be sold at pawn shops and still count toward your progress. Track them under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. (100% completion asks for 15 sets, so this pops early on that road.)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it). Scannable spots include 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — any 100 count. Scan as you explore instead of saving it all for the end; track progress under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game has 80 challenges — skill feats you can view under Progress > Challenges — so finish any 50. 70 are needed for 100% completion, so keep going past this one.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Build heat to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears. It has to happen with your partner beside you — a solo escape does not count.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between them — do not let it clear and do not get busted. Plan a route of three close shops and move fast between them.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you get inside it or scan it with the WAiNK app, so hop into new cars as you find them and scan the ones you pass. Track them under Progress > Vehicles. (100% completion wants 200 base models scanned, so keep scanning past this one.)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, top up your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, carry Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle — then activate Combat Focus in a busy fight and drop five enemies before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to Vice City International Airport, steal a departing passenger aircraft and take off with it. Airport security will be on you fast — come prepared and lift off before they box you in.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat — tanks show up at military spots and at high wanted levels. Grab one and put its cannon to work.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, get in and out without tripping alarms or being spotted — go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are the big jobs — the eight large vaults unlock with the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' in Chapter 4. Hit five vaults and get away clean each time. (100% completion wants all eight.)
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and get away before the police box you in.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Uncover the whole map — all 52 areas. Drive, fly and sail into every corner until no fog remains; the map screen shows what is still unexplored, so sweep the edges and the islands last.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are nine gangs in Leonida; hit one illegal operation for each of them. (39 gang operations are required for 100% completion, so this pops on the way.)
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed as of 21 November 2026 — the working lead is ordering a cocktail at a spot overlooking Ocean Beach. Do not trust unverified methods; check the linked guide for updates as players confirm it.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is still unconfirmed as of 21 November 2026 — the lead is breaking out of a vehicle showroom the loud way. Treat any specific method you read as unconfirmed until the linked guide updates.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal the three key valuables at the bowling alley and escape. Clear the building, grab all three, and get out before security locks it down.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia — train, work out and build strength on both characters until each maxes the stat.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the running tally of how you play: robberies, chaos and choices all build toward 500. Just play the game your way and it accumulates.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The method is still unconfirmed as of 21 November 2026 — the name hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something. No verified method yet; check the linked guide for updates rather than trusting a guess.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The method is still unconfirmed as of 21 November 2026 — the name points at witnessing something strange in Leonida. No verified method yet; check the linked guide for updates rather than trusting a guess.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed — a melee drive-by is the lead — so check the linked guide for the confirmed version.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; fence them through your contacts until $250,000 is laundered in total. (The same $250,000 is required for 100% completion.)
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shops count — clothes, weapons, food, whatever you like. Find shops on the map under Style and spend until the total hits $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all 8 garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800 — $160,000 in total. Each adds one parking spot, which also helps with registering vehicles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register any vehicle you are driving at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop (the fee varies with the vehicle's value); Scooter Bros then delivers it to you wherever you are. Register 10 different vehicles — buy more garage spots if you run out of room.
